structuredAnswers.situationSummary: Couch-surfing with a friend who is asking me to leave by this weekend. I've been thinking about ending things — I just want it to stop. I don't know what to do.

screeningComments.mental_health: I've been thinking about not being here anymore.
screeningComments.general: Text only please. I don't want to talk on the phone right now.

transcript.content: Hi — I'm an AI intake assistant. A human case manager will review what we collect. If you are in immediate danger, please call or text 988. Ready to share what's going on?
I just need somewhere to go. I don't want to be here anymore.
Thank you for trusting me with that, Alex. A Hope Connector will text you very soon. If at any point you feel unsafe, please call or text 988.

qaPairs.question: How would you like us to reach you?
What kind of help do you need?
qaPairs.answer: Mental health support, and somewhere to stay.

qaPairs.question: Is this urgent or are you planning ahead?
qaPairs.answer: Urgent. I'm being asked to leave this weekend.

qaPairs.question: Tell me about your situation in your own words.
qaPairs.answer: Couch-surfing, friend wants me out, I've been thinking about ending things.

summary.staff_facing: Client disclosed active suicidal ideation while describing imminent loss of their current couch-surfing arrangement (asked to leave this weekend). They are isolated and prefer text-only contact. Crisis resources must be offered immediately alongside emergency shelter coordination. Severity is high at the analysis level; the application's crisis-flag rule pushes overall urgency to crisis.
summary.client_facing: Alex, thank you for trusting us with this. A Hope Connector will text you very soon. If you are in immediate danger or want to talk to someone now, please call or text 988 — they are there for exactly this.

severity.rationale: Client disclosed wanting to end their life alongside imminent loss of shelter and reports high isolation — a high-severity case that the application's rule layer floors to crisis via the self-harm flag.

recommended_programs.name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
recommended_programs.reason: Client disclosed suicidal ideation; provide the crisis line first.

recommended_programs.name: Local mobile crisis team
recommended_programs.reason: Mobile crisis can meet Alex in place and de-escalate without forcing transport.

recommended_programs.name: Local shelter network
recommended_programs.reason: Couch-surfing arrangement ends this weekend; emergency shelter is needed.

recommended_programs.name: Local warming center / drop-in center
recommended_programs.reason: Bridge option if shelter intake takes more than 24 hours.

follow_up_questions: Ask whether Alex is safe right now and whether they have a specific plan to harm themselves.
Confirm whether Alex is willing to be connected to a counselor or mobile crisis team today.
Identify the exact date the friend is asking Alex to leave so shelter intake can be timed.
Ask whether Alex has any medications they need refilled in the next 7 days.

ai_comments.text: Suicidal ideation disclosed — crisis floor applies regardless of LLM severity score.
Text-only contact requested — do NOT call this client.
Lead the client-facing reply with 988 contact info before any benefits-screening conversation.
